correctness.rationale: A complete proof identifies disjoint four-symbol phase languages, so every output factor of length at least four inherits exactly the multiplicity of its covering parent. A boundary lift of length 3l-4 sends each parent MUS to a child MUS and every unique child factor contains such a lift. The nine-letter base word has five MUSs, all length three; W3 already contains all eight binary factors of length three at least twice. Thus induction excludes all alternatives. Independent direct counting and suffix-array verification agrees through n=8; all 3402 small parent-transfer comparisons pass. No finite data is used in place of the induction.
